# Test Plan — F32 Fix Colisao Areia e Grama

**Feature:** F32
**Generated by:** TEA (Test Architect)
**Date:** 2026-09-30

## 1. Scope

Validar que blocos `sand` e `dirt` passam a ter colisao fisica solida, impedindo a Mel de atravessar o terreno. Verificar ausencia de regressao em outros blocos nao-solidos.

## 2. Test strategy

- **Type:** Manual testing no browser (sem test framework configurado)
- **Environment:** Dev local via `pnpm dev` no frontend
- **Focus:** Colisao fisica (Rapier), ground detection (ray cast), sensor behavior

## 3. Unit tests

Nao aplicavel — projeto sem framework de unit test configurado. Validacao via inspecao de codigo:

| Check | File | Expected |
|-------|------|----------|
| sand.solid === true | packages/shared/src/types.ts:82 | `solid: true` |
| dirt.solid === true | packages/shared/src/types.ts:85 | `solid: true` |
| Block sensor logic | packages/frontend/src/game/entities/Block.tsx:65 | `sensor={!props.solid && !props.dangerous}` (unchanged) |

## 4. Integration tests

| ID | Scenario | Steps | Expected result |
|----|----------|-------|-----------------|
| IT-01 | Mel stands on dirt | Start game, observe Mel spawn | Mel lands on dirt surface, does not fall through |
| IT-02 | Mel walks on dirt | Move left/right on terrain | Mel walks normally on dirt blocks |
| IT-03 | Mel jumps on dirt | Press Space on dirt, wait to land | Mel jumps and lands back on dirt, grounded=true |
| IT-04 | Sand collision | Place sand in editor, walk Mel onto it | Mel stands on sand, does not fall through |

## 5. Regression tests

| ID | Scenario | Steps | Expected result |
|----|----------|-------|-----------------|
| RT-01 | Water passable | Walk Mel into water block | Mel passes through water (sensor) |
| RT-02 | Lava dangerous | Walk Mel into lava block | Mel passes through but takes damage |
| RT-03 | Leaf platform | Jump onto leaf block | Leaf behaves as platform (passable from below, solid from above) |
| RT-04 | Solid blocks | Walk into stone/iron/brick | Mel collides normally (no regression) |
| RT-05 | Destructible blocks | Shoot wood/glass with Z | Blocks are destroyed normally |
| RT-06 | Fly mechanics | Hold Space in air | Fly works with 5s timer (F31 not regressed) |
| RT-07 | Coin collection | Walk into coins | Coins collected normally |

## 6. Edge cases

| ID | Scenario | Expected |
|----|----------|----------|
| EC-01 | Mel spawns directly above dirt | Mel falls and lands (no infinite fall) |
| EC-02 | Rapid jump on dirt | Repeated Space presses — always re-grounds on dirt |
| EC-03 | Dirt at chunk boundary | Walking across chunks — dirt collision consistent |

## 7. Acceptance matrix

| Criterion | Test IDs |
|-----------|----------|
| Mel walks on dirt without falling | IT-01, IT-02, IT-03 |
| Mel walks on sand without falling | IT-04 |
| Ground detection works on dirt/sand | IT-01, IT-03, EC-01, EC-02 |
| No regression on water/lava/leaf | RT-01, RT-02, RT-03 |
| No regression on solid/destructible blocks | RT-04, RT-05 |
| Game runs without console errors | All tests |
